newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends up slightly, networking stocks soar.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends up slightly, networking stocks soar.

text.p: Nasdaq shares pushed to a new record high for the third consecutive session as networking stocks continued to soar on growing optimism on sales and earnings, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 0.97 points, or 0.07 percent, to close unofficially at 1410.18, topping the previous record set on Tuesday. Advancing issues beat declines 2159 to 2026 on total volume of 654 million shares. The Russell 2000 index, a key index of small capitalization stocks, added 1.05 points, or 0.28 percent to 377.79, also a new record.
Although Nasdaq eeked out a small gain on Wednesday, the increases were not as broad as Tuesday's rally, traders said.

"At these levels, the rally thinned out a bit. There's an improved outlook on the networking stocks, but the chip stocks and some big names like Microsoft and Intel gave up some of their gains today," one trader said.

Networking stocks soared, with 3Com Corp adding 4-3/8 to 51-1/8 and U.S. Robotics Corp jumping 7-3/4 to 88-1/2. FORE Systems Inc firmed 1-7/8 to 16-5/8. Intel Corp dropped 2-3/16 to 167-1/8, easing slightly from its record closing price of 169-5/16 set on Tuesday. Microsoft Corp slipped 3/4 to 125-7/8.
